title: Dr. Owen Muir's New Podcast Appearance!
subtitle: He joins Matthew Zackary on Out of Patients!
body_html:
The Frontier Psychiatrists is a newsletter. It is both health-themed and daily. Today, we are simply pointing out two things:

1. The newsletter is 75% off for all subscribers till Dec 1.

Subscribe now

You know what to do! And…

I was a guest on “Out of Patients” with fellow Western New York Enthusiast Matthew Zackary. He’s a fascinating healthcare agitator and a good interviewer, too. I give some answers that are long and some that are concise. We talk about music, ADHD, Depression, tuning as a metaphor for brain function, and more. I have a bunch of research papers to edit today, so I won’t go on and on here. Thanks for reading, subscribing, and supporting. As a reminder—there are over 400 articles in my paywalled back catalog. Some are even good.
